actions.label: Assess workstation
actions.description: OS, memory and disk observation; not complete device health.

actions.label: Validate and hand off
actions.description: Selected baseline and peripheral/user acceptance evidence.

actions.label: Check Windows 11 readiness
actions.description: Exact source/target edition, CPU, TPM, firmware, apps and management evidence.

actions.label: Run setup compatibility check
actions.description: Selected signed media; scan only may write logs or use Dynamic Update.

actions.label: Upgrade Windows
actions.description: Supported upgrade only after compatibility, recovery and restart approval.

actions.label: Migrate user data and settings
actions.description: Explicit source/destination, USMT scope, encryption and restore checks.

actions.label: Review local profiles
actions.description: Loaded/special/current profiles protected; uncertain age stays unknown.

actions.label: Remove selected stale profile
actions.description: Exact SID/path review, backup/retention approval and immediate revalidation.

actions.label: Review storage use
actions.description: Explicit roots, reparse/cloud exclusions, bounded counts; no deletion.

actions.label: Clean approved temporary data
actions.description: Itemized plan; preserve user folders, restore data, cloud placeholders and legal holds.

actions.label: Diagnose network and DNS
actions.description: Local scope and explicit destinations; no scanning or automatic reset.

actions.label: Diagnose printers and USB
actions.description: Queues, ports, drivers and spooler evidence before a selected test page or repair.

actions.label: Review relevant event logs
actions.description: Bounded time window, privacy filtering, symptom-specific evidence.

actions.label: Explain services and apps
actions.description: Known app/service relationships; presence does not prove health or authority.

actions.label: Explain management and policy
actions.description: Correct device/user context for AD, GPO, Entra, MDM and ConfigMgr.

actions.label: Review installed applications
actions.description: Non-repair-triggering inventory; distinguish scope, source and coverage.

actions.label: Install or update selected apps
actions.description: Exact source/version, publisher, license, dependency and one update owner.

actions.label: Review OEM drivers and firmware
actions.description: Exact model/vendor, power/recovery readiness; no generic driver bundles.

actions.label: Export Autopilot hardware hash
actions.description: Local export only unless a separately approved tenant action is chosen.

actions.label: Request management sync
actions.description: Single authorized tenant/device; request acceptance differs from completed processing.

actions.label: Configure name or printer
actions.description: Validated naming/approved driver inputs; no implicit domain join.

actions.label: Restart selected computers
actions.description: Resolve exact targets, warn signed-in users and require explicit confirmation.

actions.label: Back up and report GPO
actions.description: Authorized lab or environment only; protect exported policy details.

actions.label: Review backup and restore readiness
actions.description: Existing job/result observations plus separately proven restoration.

actions.label: Plan device return or removal
actions.description: Separate reassignment, retire, cloud record deletion and data erasure.

actions.label: Find troubleshooting guidance
actions.description: Search reviewed offline runbooks with source/check dates; no agent execution.
